newsitem.title: GERMANY: German economic stagnation overcome - Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: German economic stagnation overcome - Tietmeyer.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that the economic stagnation in Germany had been overcome in the first few months of 1997.

Tiemeyer, who was speaking at a news conference, also said that economic data for the second quarter showed the economy expanding and that there was no need for people to be pessimistic about the state of the German economy.
